plugins.name: Amanamu Void Alert
plugins.author: 1k4ru5g3, POEFixer
plugins.description: Marks Amanamu (Lightless Well) abyss monsters with a ring, a label and an edge arrow whose colour shows whether the monster is still in its void cloud.
changes: First release maintained by POEFixer.
The label now sits above the monster and the ring around its body (before, both were drawn below its feet).
The edge arrow now points the right way for monsters far off screen instead of falling back to an old direction.
Much lighter on performance: monster modifiers are read once per monster and the search is spread over frames, so busy maps no longer slow the game down.
New settings tab in the POEFixer style with explanations on every option, plus colour, scale and opacity settings. Text is outlined and sizes follow the POEFixer font size.
The debug window no longer opens by default; it is in the Diagnostics section.
Settings are saved safely and automatically; your old settings are taken over.

plugins.name: Auto My Aim
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Moves the cursor onto the best monster near you while you hold a key or after a toggle, so skills cast at it; line of sight, rarity and life priority.
changes: Now maintained by POEFixer: new settings tab in the POEFixer style (cards, clear labels, explanations on every option).
Aiming now lands correctly when the game runs in a window or on a second monitor.
Line of sight now uses the new area's terrain right after a map change instead of the previous one.
The random offset no longer makes the cursor shake around the target.
Key setup: click, then press a key or mouse button; Esc cancels, Clear removes it, and a Left mouse button binds the left mouse button. A key you just set never triggers until you release it.
New in-game status chip with a choice of corner, size and opacity, and a clearer target marker and range ring.
Less work per frame: only monsters are read while aiming, and buff checks are reused instead of repeated every frame.

Choosing the target (reading monsters, line of sight, buffs) moved to a background thread: aiming no longer costs frame time. "Update every" starts at 16 ms (an old "every frame" setting becomes 16 ms).
"Pause while an item panel is open" now really notices an opened inventory, stash or vendor window (it could miss one and keep moving the cursor over it).
Settings are saved right after a change and can no longer be lost or half-written.

A settings file that cannot be read (a typo after a hand edit, or another program holding the file) is no longer replaced by the defaults: a broken file is kept as `settings.json.corrupt`, and nothing is saved until you change a setting.

plugins.name: Belt Toggle On Buff
plugins.author: 1k4ru5g3, POEFixer
plugins.description: Re-equips your belt automatically (open inventory, two clicks, close) when a Walker monster dies near you or a new stolen-modifier buff appears.
changes: First POEFixer release of Belt Toggle On Buff, with your settings from the original plugin imported automatically.
Clicks land on the belt slot in windowed mode too, and an inventory that was already open is no longer closed by the swap.
The belt is checked after the swap and clicked back on if it stayed on the cursor; otherwise you get a clear warning.
The swap stops at once if the game loses focus, the POEFixer menu opens or you press Esc, and never sends input to another window.
The stolen-modifier trigger fires once per new buff instead of every few seconds, and clearing a Walker name no longer matches every monster.
Inventory key and test key can be changed; the belt position is picked with a 3-second countdown.
Much lighter on the game: monsters are scanned only at the chosen interval and their modifiers are read once.
New settings layout with tooltips, a test button and short on-screen messages.

plugins.name: Buff Overlay
plugins.author: 1k4ru5g3, POEFixer
plugins.description: Shows chosen buffs and skill states as icons, charges, time left or custom text anywhere on screen, with a live preview and drag-to-place.
changes: First POEFixer release of Buff Overlay, with your trackers from the original plugin imported automatically.
Much lighter on the game: buffs and skills are read 20 times a second instead of every frame, and only when a tracker needs them.
Pick a buff or skill from what is active on your character; names ending in a changing number get a "Starts with" rule.
New settings layout with a live preview, plain choices for icon, text and time left, and tooltips on every option.
"Arrange on screen" lets you drag trackers with the menu open or closed and is no longer left on after a restart.
Text outline and overall opacity for better readability; time left above a minute shows as minutes:seconds.
Icons are chosen from the plugin's icons folder inside the overlay (no more blocking file dialog).
Settings save automatically and safely; removing every tracker no longer brings the example back.

plugins.name: Example Plugin
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Reference plugin for developers: live demos of every SDK service, from entities, buffs and inventories to the game UI tree, memory and prices.
changes: First versioned release.
Settings rebuilt with the shared plugin UI kit (PluginUi.h): cards, measured label columns and tooltips.

plugins.name: Farm Counter
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Records your map runs: loot value, map time, kills, gold and XP per hour, with run history and statistics per map type.
changes: First versioned release.
The version now shows in the plugin header of the Plugins tab instead of inside the settings.

plugins.name: Foretold Rewards
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Shows the priced rewards the Rite of the Nameless can offer on each atlas map, so you can plan your route before you run it.
changes: First versioned release.

plugins.name: Get Back My Zoom
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Restores a much further camera zoom-out, removes Atlas fog, reveals the whole map and enlarges the light radius, safely undone when switched off.
changes: First POEFixer release of Get Back My Zoom.
Safer patching: a change is written only where its pattern is found exactly once and the original bytes are confirmed, and the game is opened with the minimum access needed.
Changes left behind by a crash are undone automatically the next time POEFixer connects to the same game.
Disabling the plugin now really keeps it off: it no longer re-applies its changes when the game is attached again.
Restarting the game or switching to another game client is handled: changes are undone in the old process and applied to the new one.
No more stutter: the game scan and all writes run in the background instead of on a frame.
Redesigned settings tab with a clear state per feature, a "Scan again" button, a logarithmic light radius slider with "Game value", and a diagnostics card.

plugins.name: GGPK Explorer
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Browses the game's content files: searchable file tree, viewers for tables, images, models and audio, and file extraction.
changes: First versioned release.

plugins.name: Ground Effects
plugins.author: 1k4ru5g3, POEFixer
plugins.description: Draws coloured circles on dangerous ground effects (shocked, chilled, ignited ground, caustic clouds and your own rules) at their real size.
changes: First release maintained by POEFixer.
Circles now stay on the ground while the camera moves instead of trailing behind it, and a circle at the screen edge keeps its visible part instead of changing shape.
Much lighter on performance: each effect is read once, only possible ground effects are looked at, and the search is spread over frames so the game never stutters.
New settings tab in the POEFixer style: grouped cards, explanations on every option, reorderable rules, restore default rules, overall opacity, and a Diagnostics section.
Names are outlined so they stay readable on bright ground; circles get a thin dark edge.
Discover effects lists each kind of effect once and can add a rule for it in one click.
Settings are saved safely and automatically; your old settings are taken over.

plugins.name: Ninja Pricer
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Shows item prices on dropped items, in your inventory and stash, in the Ritual shop and on Runeshape rewards.
changes: First versioned release.

plugins.name: Pick My Loot
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Picks up the ground items you tick, or anything above a price you set, nearest first, using POEFixer prices; pauses on panels, enemies, town or menu.
changes: Now maintained by POEFixer: new settings tab in the POEFixer style (cards, clear labels, explanations on every option).
Prices now come from POEFixer's own price list: no separate downloads, and unique-item prices no longer leak onto plain bases.
New league items appear in their category by themselves once you have seen one on the ground.
Clicks now land correctly when the game runs in a window or on a second monitor.
An item that cannot be picked (full inventory, hidden label) is no longer clicked forever: it is skipped after 4 tries.
The cursor returns once after a whole pile instead of after every item, and Auto My Aim resumes right after picking ends.
The enemy check no longer counts friendly or hidden monsters, and less work is done per frame.
"An item panel is open" now really notices an opened inventory, stash or vendor window (it could miss one and click into it), and picking waits until it has checked.
All reading of the game (ground items, monsters, inventories, prices) moved to a background thread: picking no longer costs frame time.
Settings are saved right after a change and can no longer be lost or half-written.

A settings file that cannot be read (a typo after a hand edit, or another program holding the file) is no longer replaced by the defaults: a broken file is kept as `settings.json.corrupt`, and nothing is saved until you change a setting.
The start key is set with a click, then a key press (Esc cancels, Clear removes it); the left and right mouse buttons are refused.
On a wide settings pane the item categories sit in two columns.

plugins.name: Quick Stash
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: One-click Transfer from your backpack into the open stash, vendor or trade window, and TAKE from the stash by the game's own item search.
changes: First POEFixer release: runs smoothly even with full stash tabs; item reading moved off the game frame.
TAKE search now works like the game's: several words, "quoted phrases", !exclusions, a|b and regular expressions.
Searching in Russian, Korean, Chinese and other languages ignores capital letters correctly; mods can be searched in your client's language.
TAKE waits until all items are read, stops when you open another stash tab or your backpack is full, and no longer matches hidden mod ids.
A run stops when the POEFixer menu opens; alt-tab no longer moves your cursor in another program.
Redesigned settings (exclusion map you can drag across, live status, Diagnostics with a copyable report) and crisper in-game buttons that scale with the game.
Settings are saved safely and only when changed; a damaged or locked settings file is kept (copied to settings.json.corrupt) instead of being replaced by the defaults.

plugins.name: Radar
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Draws nearby monsters, NPCs, chests, area transitions and the walkable map on the in-game large map.
changes: First versioned release.

plugins.name: Ritual Helper
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Highlights the Ritual rewards you want in the Favours window, shows their prices and defers them all with one click.
changes: Now part of POEFixer: prices come from the overlay's price service (Settings > Prices picks the league and source), so the plugin no longer downloads prices itself.
The Favours window is found on its own, even when no other plugin is scanning inventories, and is read in the background: no more stutter while it is open.
DEFER clicks the right places in windowed mode, stops when the window closes, the overlay menu opens, the mouse moves or Esc is pressed, and waits for defer mode to really be on.
Values count the whole stack, and a plain base item no longer takes the price of a unique on the same base.
New settings page: cards, a search over every item, a list of what you ticked, and ticking straight from the open Favours window. New: highlight colour and time per click.
Highlights and labels scale with the font and stay readable on bright scenes.
Removed: the plugin's own enable switch, league selector and price refresh options (the Plugins tab and Settings > Prices cover them). Your ticked items and other settings are kept.
A damaged or locked settings file is no longer replaced by the defaults: it is kept (copied to settings.json.corrupt) until you change a setting.

plugins.name: Sekhema Helper
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Trial of the Sekhemas helper: scores every room, recommends the best route to the boss and marks it on the in-game map.
changes: First versioned release.

plugins.name: Skill DPS
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Shows the game's own DPS for each skill on your skill-bar icons, plus an optional movable list of every evaluated skill including minions.
changes: First POEFixer release of Skill DPS.
Much lighter on frame time: the skill bar is found once and remembered instead of being searched four times a second, and "Include minions" no longer reads every item on the ground.
Works at 1440p and 4K: icon and label sizes now follow the game's resolution.
If a game update moves where a bar slot keeps its skill, the plugin finds it again by itself and never shows a wrong number meanwhile.
New look for the numbers: adjustable size, background, position and colours, with a dark outline for readability; drawn under the POEFixer menu.
The DPS list is a movable panel (drag it while the settings tab is open) with size and opacity settings and compact numbers (12.3k, 4.56M).
Redesigned settings tab; diagnostics moved into one collapsed card.

plugins.name: Tablet Helper
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Highlights Precursor Tablets in your inventory, stash, guild stash and merchant windows, coloured by type and filtered by bonuses, roll values and uses left.
changes: Now maintained by POEFixer: new settings tab in the POEFixer style (cards, clear labels, a tooltip on every control, a live "on screen / highlighted" status).
Tablets in your inventory are highlighted again (the backpack grid was skipped).
No more stutter with large stashes: tablets are found and read in the background, and the highlights follow tab switches sooner.
Labels stay inside their tablet's cell at one even size; uses left is a ×N corner badge, and matched bonuses show as names or a ✓N count when the cell is too small.
Highlights draw behind the POEFixer window while it is open instead of over it.
With "Read tablet modifiers" off, every enabled type is highlighted by type, as described (bonus and uses-left filters no longer hide everything).

Settings save about a second after each change and can no longer be lost to a half-written file; a damaged file is kept as settings.json.corrupt. After an area change, tablets are re-read instead of reusing an old reading.
The duplicate "Enable Tablet Helper" and "Show overlay" switches were removed: use the plugin's Enabled switch.

plugins.name: Waystone Helper
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Marks waystones in your inventory and stash with affix-count, map-stat and affix-group badges, coloured borders by your own rules, and a hover breakdown.
changes: Now maintained by POEFixer; the affix table is built in, so no data file is needed next to the plugin.
Waystones are found and read in the background, off the game frame: no periodic stutter with a full stash tab, and no reading at all while you are away from the game.
Badges update right after you use currency on a waystone, and follow stash tab switches faster.
Map-stat badges keep working after a game patch: the plugin re-detects the stat numbers from your waystones.
Fixed a possible crash when turning "Read item mods" off while a stash was open.
Badges stay inside their waystone, scale with the overlay font and sit behind the Fixer menu while it is open.
Border groups can be moved up and down (the first matching group wins) and show a summary of their conditions.
Redesigned settings tab and hover panel; settings are saved as soon as you change them, and safely; a damaged or locked settings file is kept instead of being replaced by the defaults.
